road.name: Upper Hoh Road
road.status: Paved to the trailhead; Upper Hoh Road was washed out by a bomb-cyclone storm and closed from Dec 2025 until reopening in May 2026 after state-funded emergency repairs — check current NPS road-conditions alerts before relying on it
road.driveNote: About 19 mi off US-101 via the Upper Hoh Road to the Hoh Rain Forest Visitor Center.
